items.ref: ADR-0008 #2; r3/r4 agree
items.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 4bc292fc 'fix(hooks): claude-code Bash modify -> deny (CC ignores updatedInput.command)', and 51570583 'docs(v2): algorithmic deny + compaction (ADR-0008/0009 r2)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT (f105f45d): 'ADR-0008 r3 keep v1 deny scope, replace the mechanisms behind its issues' — i.e. v1 hard-denied curl via a brittle per-command detector that broke compound commands; v2 keeps the deny outcome but replaces the mechanism. REGRESSION_RISK: if v2's replacement detector still parses compound commands by string match instead of a shell-aware check, #1269 re-opens. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: deny decision must not depend on substring scanning of the whole command line.
items.regressions: Re-opens only if v2 deny logic reuses substring/regex scanning on the full command string (owner decision bans regex/truncation as a reduction mechanism per DECISIONS-r3) — verify TECH-SPEC's actual deny implementation does not do this.
items.question: Does the v2 deny mechanism parse the command as a shell AST, or still substring-match? If substring, #1269 is not actually fixed.
items.recommendation: Add explicit GP3 case: compound command containing 'curl' inside quotes/grep must still run; verify implementation path before marking closed-by-design final.

items.ref: D2 ensure-deps removed
items.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY chain: 0b5717c5 'fix(heal): install better-sqlite3 when package directory is missing (closes #514 partial)', 5b6ef81a 'fix(upgrade): verify better-sqlite3 binding after install, fail loud', 6471cf3b 'fix(ensure-deps): skip rebuild when binary already loads (#540)', 106bdab0/49860196 'fix(codex): detach background npm install so MCP boot doesn't blow Codex's 30s timeout (#634/#638)', b3a26354 'fix(windows): run better-sqlite3 boot-install via node, not npm.cmd+shell (#861 follow-up)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: each commit patched one more failure mode of the same runtime-install design (binding verify, skip-rebuild, detach-from-boot, Windows shell quoting) without removing the install step itself. REGRESSION_RISK: this is a 5+ commit regression chain on one mechanism (#514->#540->#634->#638->#861); v2 removing ensure-deps entirely (D2, bundled deps) is the correct fix, but ONLY if build-time bundling truly covers every platform (win/mac/linux) that these patches individually fixed (e.g. Windows shell:true cwd drop in e918eac6).
items.regressions: Blocker-class risk if v2 bundling misses the Windows-specific native-module case that needed 3 separate follow-up patches (#861, #861-followup) — this was the hardest platform to get right historically.
items.question: Does v2 bundling include a prebuilt better-sqlite3 (or equivalent) binary per platform, matching what the 5-commit ensure-deps chain was fixing? If v2 still does any native build/install step on Windows, this issue class can recur.
items.recommendation: Treat as closed-by-design only after confirming no native-module install step remains on any platform at MCP boot; add a GP case specifically for Windows cold-start with no network, mirroring the #861 scenario.
